item.title: bussilab.cli v0.0.52
item.description: • Added notify --no-unfurl, --markdown-file, and support for multiple paths with --file. • Made invalid command-line arguments exit with argparse's status code instead of printing a Python traceback; cli() still raises TypeError for parser errors by default when called from Python. • Preserved two-dimensional WHAM input from single-row and single-column files. Added clear errors for --use-frame-weight without a bias column and --traj-weight without values. • Made commands registered after import available to subsequent cli() calls by rebuilding the cached parser when needed. • Expanded command usage notes and clarified the generated CLI documentation.
item.content:encoded:
• Added notify --no-unfurl, --markdown-file, and support for multiple paths with --file.
  • Made invalid command-line arguments exit with argparse's status code instead of printing a Python traceback; cli() still raises TypeError for parser errors by default when called from Python.
  • Preserved two-dimensional WHAM input from single-row and single-column files. Added clear errors for --use-frame-weight without a bias column and --traj-weight without values.
  • Made commands registered after import available to subsequent cli() calls by rebuilding the cached parser when needed.
  • Expanded command usage notes and clarified the generated CLI documentation.
